Tuwaiq Lunar | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Tuwaiq Lunar is a Saudi-led, multidisciplinary space engineering team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 through the Universal Event.

Our team is tackling the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge by developing an interactive, scientifically grounded platform using NASA data to analyze lunar terrain, solar illumination, Earth visibility, and mission feasibility.

Our members bring expertise in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Remote Sensing, GIS, and scientific data analysis.

We aim to combine engineering simulations, scientific accuracy, and advanced visualization to help users evaluate and compare potential lunar landing sites.

We are seeking members skilled in Software Engineering, Python, Full-Stack Development, 3D Visualization, and UI/UX Design.

Our mission is to transform complex lunar data into an accessible and reliable decision-support tool.
